GBQualifier.GBQualifier_value: Sequencing determined that the original isolate was a mix of LPAIV and HPAIV. To obtain a preparation with only HPAIV, the first embryonated chicken eggs (ECE) passage of the field HPAIV isolate was passaged in 10-day-old ECEs and then passaged a second time in 14-day-old ECEs, which is a procedure that has been shown to select for HPAIV. Brain tissue harvested from embryos after the second ECE passage were homogenized and subjected to another passage in 14-day-old ECEs.
